author: Bellular News
description:
John and Brenda Romero say today's games industry is "definitely crashier" than the 80s. This is the modern crash behind game development: rising budgets, disappearing funding, layoffs, and why a few brilliant indie-backed funds can help but cannot save the industry alone.

Join us at http://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!

01:05 The Crash That's Already Here

05:44 The Money Ran Out
12:21 The Indies Trying To Fix It
13:45 Why Indies Can't Save Us
